# Galaxy background

Asset: `galaxy-v1.png`. Generated with the built-in ImageGen tool for the local Road to CELE UI. This background is decorative; constellation geometry is rendered separately from chart data.

## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape background texture for a Civil Engineering constellation skill-tree game website. Create a sophisticated richly textured deep-space night sky painting, wide 16:9 composition. Inky almost-black navy and blue-green cosmic cloud filaments, softly luminous diffuse wisps and subtle smoky dust, many very tiny scattered pinprick stars, with occasional soft muted warm amber stardust clusters. The clouds are textured and irregular, visually reminiscent of a premium fantasy video game's celestial skill tree backdrop. Dark overall for comfortable long-session use, clouds visible with depth and detail but not bright. Keep much of the scene quiet and dark so interactive nodes and text can be overlaid legibly. No planets, no large glowing spheres, no atoms, no orbital diagrams, no constellation lines, no game UI, no text, no logos, no borders, no watermark. This is only the background art; real constellation stars and paths will be added in code. Matte atmospheric cinematic concept art, organic texture, not a flat gradient.
